manual_polygons.reason: NW settlement west of the E20: scattered plots in 2000, a dense block of compounds, walls and plots by 2013 that keeps growing to 2025. Built-up change, not dune motion.

E20 (Sweihan Road) corridor in the NW: a single carriageway in 2000, realigned and dualled by 2013 (the 2000 and 2013 alignments differ by up to ~50 m), with an interchange at 24.480 N. OSM buffers only the current line.
Levelled and fenced area north of the E16 (a diamond-shaped enclosure with a pushed-up sand pile inside, and fenced plots south-east of it): dunes in 2000 and 2013, graded by 2025.
Elongated flat inside the northern dune belt (WNW-ESE, ~1.8 x 0.4 km): a graded strip already in 2013, excavated and brighter by 2022-2025. Non-dune surface with non-dune change.
Housing grid west of the junction (absent in 2013, street grid by 2019-2025) on a long flat strip parallel to the E16 that was dark in 2000 and pale in 2013 (graded ground).
Military compound north of the E16 and the fenced plots added beside it after 2013 (new buildings and walls 2013-2025).
New fenced compound in the NE corner, absent in 2013, present in 2025.
Farm corridor east of the town between the E16 and the southern dunes: plots added, abandoned and re-fenced between 2000 and 2025 (unvegetated plots are missed by NDVI/WorldCover).

Abandoned farm grid in the SE: irrigated plots in 2000, faded to a grid of tracks/walls by 2013 and being covered by sand from the north-west by 2025. A sand-encroachment target for notebook 03, not a tracking area: its static grid would pull dune speeds toward zero.
Water tanks/pond built south of the town between 2000 and 2013.
Compound at the southern edge of the SW dune belt that grew between 2000 and 2025, with a new fenced enclosure to its south (2025).
Fenced plots and compounds on the gravel flat south-east of the road (new fence lines 2013-2025).

Graded bright patches, tracks, a camp and a dark structure added on the gravel flat along the toe of the SW dune belt between 2013 and 2025 (55.286-55.320 E). Found after the first runs: windows centred on this flat showed 2-8 m/yr toward the NE with low match quality (0.2-0.3), out of line with the belt (about 1 m/yr toward the east).

scene_masks.reason: Cluster of small cumulus shadows over the northern dune belt on 2022-11-08 (largest ~300 m at 55.336 E 24.505 N, four to five smaller ones down to 24.489 N), dark in B8 and slightly cool in thermal, flagged in only 0.001 % of the box by QA_PIXEL. Seen by comparing with 2021-11-13 and 2023-11-19 at full resolution.

synthetic_tests.summary: clean shifts up to 8 px recovered with |bias| <= 0.1 px; with noise+contrast+brightness+gamma changes, bias <= 0.05 px for shifts <= 3 px and 44 % failures for shifts > 3 px; with non-dune pixels masked, bias <= 0.05 px

match_quality_threshold.definition: 99th percentile of phase-correlation peak heights for windows matched against unrelated windows 40 px away

registration_check.rule: if >= 20 stable windows have vegetation fraction <= 0.25, their registration trend is compared with the trend of all stable windows (nothing added); otherwise the full trend of all stable windows is added as a systematic velocity uncertainty

noise_and_detection.detection_limit_definition: speed > 2.45 x calibrated per-component sigma (95 % for a 2-D null)

interannual.decision: judged against the dune-specific noise from the illumination-test pairs (the stable-ground spread is a lower bound)

wind_correlation.note: MERRA-2 hourly 10 m wind, Fryberger weighting, resultant drift per interval projected on the field-mean dune direction

HLSS30.independence: independent satellite and sensor (Sentinel-2 MSI), independent geolocation (AROP_NCP = 0), red band at 30 m; shares place, season, masks and code

HLSL30.independence: NOT independent: same Landsat 8/9 OLI instruments as the primary data; tests band (red vs pan), 30 m resolution and HLS processing only

velocity_field_table.columns_note: x_m/y_m = window centre in the site CRS; sigma_myr = calibrated per-component 1-sigma; detected = speed > detection_limit_myr (= 2.45 sigma); speeds/headings blank where not valid

draa_bodies.definition: NASADEM crests >= 6.9 m above the DEM opened with a 1500 m disk, outline (upper half) >= 0.25 km2, DEM shading matching the image
draa_bodies.height_note: relief above the DEM opened with the base disk; on a regional slope or escarpment it includes part of that step
draa_bodies.body_motion: not measured: on images low-passed to the body scale the matcher does not recover known shifts (it returns close to zero shift), so a body 'velocity' from it would be the registration offsets mirrored, not body motion. Body motion is below what this method can resolve; no speed is reported.

draa_bodies.note: A QC/interpretation product: these bodies are not added to dunes.geojson, whose outlines stay at the bedform scale (the same at every site).

height_model.flux_equivalent_note: k = speed x height ~ bulk sand flux per unit crest length (m^2/yr)

window_level.note: relief = 95th percentile of (NASADEM - local base) in each 480 m window; NASADEM noise 2.3 m, so low-relief terciles are partly noise

min_resolvable.rule: crest >= 6.9 m (3 x NASADEM noise) and DEM shading matching the image
